metadata.title: One North East - Press Conference | Pradyot Kishor Manikya | Conrad Sangma | प्रद्योत किशोर माणिक्य
metadata.description: The TIPRA Motha chief, Pradyot Kishor Manikya Debbarma and Conrad Sangma, along with several prominent leaders from the North Eastern states, are holding a significant press conference at the Constitution Club of India, New Delhi. Leaders from Tripura, Meghalaya, Assam, and Nagaland are participating in the event. The meeting is expected to address crucial issues concerning the North Eastern region and regional political unity.
